description: Bullrun's proprietary machine-learning valuation and forecast scores for 1-10 stocks, recomputed nightly. Valuation: a LightGBM model predicts the P/E (or price/sales for loss-makers) that companies with similar fundamentals typically command a year out; the gap = typical / current multiple - 1 (positive = trades below its typical multiple), with the implied model-typical P/E, percentile and rank in the scored universe. Forecast: a relative 1-year return-rank signal with percentile. Both on quarterly and on annual financials (annual covers most non-US companies). Use for "is X cheap or expensive", "what's X's fair P/E", "compare valuations of X, Y, Z", or a valuation sanity check before buying. Descriptive context, not a price target or recommendation. Read-only.

tickers.description: 1-10 Bullrun tickers, e.g. ["AAPL","MSFT"] or ["ASML","SAP","NESN"]. Use the listing ticker returned by search_stocks. US/European examples: AAPL, BMW, NESN. Most Asian listings keep their exchange suffix (6324.T, 0700.HK); some use bare codes (005930). Native or suffixed forms resolve only when one listing matches; search by company name or ISIN if unsure.
